name: TRINITY_R12_HF_INTERNAL_SHIFT_CORRECTION
source_root_cause: HF AutoModelForCausalLM shifts labels by one internally. R1.1 mistakenly pre-shifted both input and labels; loss was optimized on misaligned next-token targets.
code_fix: Use unshifted complete prompt+answer input_ids; mask all prompt label tokens; let HF shift logits/labels internally.

new_firstlook.purpose: Different numeric domain, first evaluated only after corrected adapter is trained

next: Read new R12 CPU GitHub Actions full artifacts and record full score, including negative result. If internally better, obtain truly withheld third-party critic and 3 external student cohorts before any graduation.
